spans.s: तल (I) m.n. (the word is sometimes used at the end of compounds almost without any meaning, as in हिमधाम्नि दर्पणतले च मुहुः स्वमुखश्रियं मृगदृशो ददृशुः Sis.ix.53) 1. A surface, भुवस्तलमिव व्योम कुर्वन् व्योमेव भूतलम् R.iv.29, K.S.i.55, Rt.i.3; 2. the palm of the hand or the sole of the foot, R.vi.18, Bhartr.i.20; 3. the fore-arm; 4. a slap with the hand; 5. lowness, inferiority of position; 6. lower part, bottom, छायामिवादर्शतलं प्रविष्टाम् R.xvi.6; 7. the ground under a tree or any other object, Rt.i.13; 8. a hole, a pit.
तल (II) m. 1. The hilt of a sword; 2. the palmyra tree.
तल (III) n. 1. A pond; 2. a forest; 3. cause, origin, motive; 4. a leathern fence wound round the left arm.
तला f. The leathern glove of an archer.

ताल m. 1. The palmyra tree, R.xv.23; 2. a banner formed of the palm; 3. clapping the hands together; 4. beating time (in music), Megh.ii.16; 5. a kind of musical instrument made of bell-metal, R.ix.71; 6. the palm of the hand; 7. a lock, a bolt; 8. the hilt of a sword.
ताल (II) n. 1. The nut of the palmyra tree; 2. yellow orpiment.
तल-अंगुलि f. a toe.
तल-अची f. a mat.
तल-अतल n. the fourth of the seven infernal regions.
तल-ताल m. a kind of musical instrument.
तल-ईक्षण m. a hog.
तल-उदा f. a river.
तल-घात m. a slap with the palm of the hand.
तल-तस् ind. from the bottom.
तल-त्र, -त्राण, -वारण n. the leathern glove of an archer.
तल-त्र, -त्राण, -वारण n. the leathern glove of an archer.
तल-त्र, -त्राण, -वारण n. the leathern glove of an archer.
तल-प्रहार m. slap with the hand.
तल-सारक n. a martingale.
तलक n. A large pond.
तालक n. 1. Yellow orpiment; 2. a bolt, a latch.
तलिका f. A martingale.
तल्लिका f. A key.
तालिक m. 1. The open palm of the hand; 2. clapping the hands, यथैकेन न हस्तेन तालिकः संप्रपद्यते Panch.ii.
तालिका f. Clapping the hands, उच्चाटनीयः करतालिकानां दानादिदानीं भवतीभिरेषः Na.iii.7.
तलित n. Fried meat.
तालित n. 1. Coloured cloth; 2. a string.
तलिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Thin, spare; 2. small, little; 3. clear, clean; 4. situated under or beneath.
तलिन (II) n. A bed, a couch.
तलिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Thin, spare; 2. small, little; 3. clear, clean; 4. situated under or beneath.
तलिम n. 1. Paved ground, a pavement; 2. a bed, a couch; 3. a sword; 4. an awning.
तलुन m. A wind.
तल्क n. A forest.
तल्प m.n. 1. A couch, a bed, a sofa, सपदि विगतनिद्रस्तल्पमुज्झांचकार R.v.75; 2. a wife, as in गुरुतल्पग; 3. the seat of a carriage; 4. an upper story, a turret, a tower.
तल्पक m. A servant whose business it is to make beds.

तल्लज m. Excellence, excellent.(This word is used at the end of compounds to express ‘excellence’ and is always masculine, whatever the gender of the first member of the compound, e.g. कुमारीतल्लज (m.) ‘an excellent girl.’)
तल्ली f. A youthful woman.
ताली f. 1. A species of the mountain palm, R.iv.34, vi.57; 2. tāḍi liquor; 3. a key.
ताल-अंक m. 1. an epithet of Balarāma; 2. the palm leaf used for writing; 3. a saw.
तालंक m. A kind of ear-ornament, (the same as ताडंक).
ताल-अवचर m. a dancer, an actor.
ताल-केतु m. an epithet of Bhīṣma.
ताल-क्षीरक n. the exudation of the palm.
ताल-गर्भ m. the exudation of the palm.
ताल-ध्वज, -भृत् m. an epithet of Balarāma.
ताल-ध्वज, -भृत् m. an epithet of Balarāma.
ताल-पत्र n. 1. the palm leaf used for writing; 2. a kind of ear-ornament.
ताल-बद्ध, -शुद्ध a. measured, regulated by musical time.
ताल-बद्ध, -शुद्ध a. measured, regulated by musical time.
ताल-मर्दल m. a kind of musical instrument.
ताल-यंत्र n. a kind of surgical instrument.
ताल-रेचनक m. a dancer, an actor.
ताल-लक्षण m. an epithet of Balarāma.
ताल-वन n. a grove of trees.
ताल-वृंत n. a fan, K.S.ii.35.
तालक-आभ m. the green colour.
तालव्य a. (f. व्या) relating to the palate, palatal.
तालव्य a. (f. व्या) relating to the palate, palatal.
तालव्य-वर्ण m. a palatal letter; they are इ, ई, च्, छ्, ज्, झ्, ञ् and य्.
तालव्य-स्वर m. a palatal vowel; they are इ and ई.
तालु n. The palate, तृषा महत्या परिशुष्कतालवः Rt.i.11.
तालु-जिह्व m. a crocodile.
तालु-स्थान a. palatal.
तालूर m. A whirlpool.
तालूषक n. The palate.
